name: reprospec-marketplace
description: ReproSpec: staged, gated reproduction of figures and quantitative claims from data-driven papers and research reports.

plugins.name: reprospec
plugins.description: ReproSpec: reproduce a paper's results through a staged, gated workflow (init, outline, plan, detail, analyse, reproduce, verify, rework, adjust, organize, audit, deliver) with explicit definition-substitution and data-integrity policies, plus a consent-gated feedback skill that files reproduction problems as GitHub issues.
